g.text: PROJECT · Context persists beyond a Session
CONTROL PLANE · permission is independent of shared content
SESSION CONSUMPTION SCOPE · one of many independent scopes
Green = content / evidence · Blue = authority / admission · Amber = versioned boundary
Dashed = candidate or unimplemented adapter, never an active permission path.
Project and Session boxes are responsibility scopes, not a one-owner containment tree.
Issued sources · names are not identity
